text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp☆ Let's do our best, 
Rickey-chan!

We had a reassuring ally at this year's 
summer training camp. It seems Smart 
Falcon will be joining in on our training.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's do tons of training together, okay? 
And then, inspired by seeing us like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't it be great if she felt like, 'I 
want to stand on that stage once more!' 
Tarumae-chan☆"

Though she agreed, Copano Rickey's 
expression showed no signs of optimism.

She probably knows from feng shui that it 
won't be easy. Even so...
choice_data_list: Ricky, all you can do is get stronger.

Ricky, all you can do is get stronger, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list:
Next time, it's Rickey's turn to pull 
Tarumae along.

Next time, it's Rickey's turn to pull 
Tarumae along!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Pulling everyone along... You're right. 
Tarumae has always been doing that—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"She was pulling me forward. As a goal far 
ahead of me. But—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The guiding wind had ceased to blow. In 
that case, next time—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I must lead the way! Yes, the one with the 
fuller spirit should take the lead!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Unless I push forward powerfully enough 
to lift the entire arena's spirits, I 
won't be able to break through this tough 
situation!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san, nice to be working with you! If 
I run with someone who's been an Umadol as 
long as you—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I think you'll understand much deeper! 
About the running, and about Tarumae's 
feelings, too!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yep♪ I'll help out with whatever I can☆

Under Smart Falcon's guidance, she went 
from a dirt rising star to a giant star 
carrying the next generation.

This summer, Copano Rickey is determined 
to take her abilities to the next level.
